about: Redacted transcripts of the end-to-end suites that move PayPal sandbox money, one entry per suite: each step with its PayPal order and capture ids, payee count, statuses and timings. Written by tests/e2e/transcript.mjs from tests/e2e/paypal-button.mjs and tests/e2e/api.mjs; no email address, key or token is kept.
